claim_boundary_notes: Batch registry preflight is not whole-batch atomic commit.
The actual frozen multi-column orchestrator is mod_fmr_serialized_multiswap_runtime.f90; the serialized reference backend is per-column physical execution authority.
Deterministic v1 ordering is template_id then column_id.
Column commits remain individually authoritative; a later rejected column does not retroactively roll back an earlier accepted column.
Aggregate diagnostics report composed per-column authority and do not override per-column transaction or mass gates.
